name: Access rights
description: Whether the data itself is available, per DCAT dct:accessRights. Publishing metadata about restricted data is legitimate and useful; publishing it without saying the data is restricted is not.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Restricted
hasDefinedTerm.description: The metadata is public; access to the data requires authorisation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Non-public
hasDefinedTerm.description: The data is not available outside the publishing body.
